summary: Tested Scooter Workshop app - both backend (14/14 pytest) and frontend (all critical flows). Public booking submission, admin login (correct/wrong), protected route enforcement, list/stats fetch, status update persistence, logout redirect, and unauth /admin redirect to /login all pass. Uses httpOnly cookie auth with axios withCredentials.

minor.issue: Non-idempotent CORS_ORIGINS='*' in .env is unused (server hardcodes FRONTEND_URL). Works because allow_origins uses FRONTEND_URL env, but CORS_ORIGINS key is stale/misleading.
preferred_date is stored as string with no server-side validation (ISO/date format). Frontend enforces min=today via HTML5 date input only; a client bypassing the UI could POST any string.
No ObjectId format validation; malformed id will raise bson.errors.InvalidId => 500 instead of 400/404. Tested only with valid-format ids.

issues: Uses browser-default HTML5 date input (min=today). Consider shadcn calendar for consistent dark-theme UX.

action_items: Optional: Add server-side date validation and ObjectId format validation to prevent 500s on bad input.
Optional: Remove unused CORS_ORIGINS from backend/.env or wire it up.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: PATCH endpoint uses ObjectId(booking_id) directly - wrap in try/except InvalidId to return 400.
server.py: hardcoded default 'admin@workshop.com'/'workshop123' fallbacks in startup() weaken security if env vars accidentally missing in prod.
server.py: cookie samesite=none + secure=true works only over HTTPS - OK for deployed env, will fail on localhost dev.
seed_data_creation: Created ~5 TEST_-prefixed bookings via API and 1 UI booking (UI Test User) during testing. Not cleaned up.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite is /app/backend/tests/test_workshop_api.py (14 tests, all pass with pytest-xdist). Auth uses httpOnly cookie 'access_token' (samesite=none, secure). Frontend axios uses withCredentials. Landing date input has min=today - use future date in playwright tests.
